name: IsPartner.mem_matchingPairs
summary: Both functions are Schwartz–Bruhat with primitive supports; at each k ∈ GL_n(F) the two local sections reduce to single values (`localSection_of_primitive`), which agree by the partner identity at an element of GL_n(O).

steps.claim: Φ is Schwartz–Bruhat on surjective matrices: the set where Φ takes a given non-zero value is clopen, being the image under k ↦ (invLastRows(e, k))ᵀ of an open and closed subset of the compact group GL_n(O) (on it Φ(x_k) = χ(det k)·Ψ(y_k) is locally constant in k: Ψ is, and χ is on units, `TameLocalChar.isLocallyConstant_invOnUnits`), and the supports consist of primitive matrices (?l), so `schwartzBruhat.of_support_primitive` applies after transposing; Ψ likewise (?r). The matching identity at k ∈ GL_n(F): x_kᵀ has a left inverse and y_k = firstCols(e, k) too, so both local sections are single values χ(det g)·(Φ∘transpose)(x_kᵀ g) and χ(det u)·Ψ(y_k u) (`localSection_of_primitive`); these agree by the partner identity at some j ∈ GL_n(O) with firstCols(e, j) = y_k·u (`exists_firstCols_eq_mul`), whose invLastRows equals that of an element i ∈ GL_n(O) (the factorization through b·u, `IsPrimitiveMatrix.mul_iff`).
steps.lean:
refine' ⟨⟨.transpose_mem_schwartzBruhat (schwartzBruhat.of_support_primitive (fun s ↦ (Set.ext _).subst (((IsLocallyConstant.zero s).union
    (hχ.isClopen_primitive _ e).2).sdiff (((isCompact_intGL isCompact_O).diff ((hΨ.comp_continuous (f := firstCols e)
    (by fun_prop)).div (hχ.isLocallyConstant_invOnUnits.comp_continuous Units.continuous_val.matrix_det) s)).image_auto
    (Matrix.transpose ∘ invLastRows e)).isClosed)) ?l), schwartzBruhat.of_support_primitive hΨ ?r⟩, funext fun k ↦ match
    localSection_of_primitive _ _ (hasLeftInv_invLastRows_transpose ..), localSection_of_primitive _ _ ⟨_, invFirstRows_mul_firstCols ..⟩ with | ⟨g, a, A⟩, ⟨u, b, B⟩ => (
                                                                           congr($(A _ ?l) - _ * $(B _ ?r)).trans ((exists_firstCols_eq_mul e k ⊤ u _ (transposeGL g) ..).elim fun j p ↦
                                                                           (_ : ∃ i ∈ intGL n O, invLastRows e j = invLastRows e i).elim (b.mul_iff (x := invFirstRows e j * firstCols e ·) |>.elim _)))⟩

steps.claim: The remaining goals (the supports are primitive; the determinant and character factors match) follow from the partner property, the identity of complementary minors (`det_fromRows_invLastRows`), the description of primitive square matrices by their determinant (`isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_isIntegralUnit_det`), and the descriptions of the matrices invLastRows(e, k), firstCols(e, k) with k ∈ GL_n(O) (`exists_invLastRows_iff_transpose`, `IsValuationPair.exists_firstCols_iff`).
steps.lean:
repeat simp_all [← mul_assoc, ← map_mul, mem_intGL (O := ⊤)] <;> grind [invOnUnits,
    isPrimitiveMatrix_iff_isIntegralUnit_det, Matrix.transpose_submatrix, Matrix.transpose_mul,
    Matrix.transpose_transpose, right_mul, det_fromRows_invLastRows, χ.map_one,
    (exists_invLastRows_iff_transpose e).trans (valPair.exists_firstCols_iff _)]
